explanation: Any of the five can go first, then any of the four left, and so on: 5 times 4 times 3 times 2 times 1 is 120. Mathematicians call it five factorial.

claims.text: Five different books can be arranged in a row in 120 different orders.
The number of orders for five different books is not 25, 60 or 100.
The product 5 x 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 equals 120 and is called five factorial.
